shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,280p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git branch --show-current && git log -5 --oneline && sed -n '1,320p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,360p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && rg -n \"specs/.*#|spec:\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -80 && rg -n \"ToolDefinition|inputSchema\" src/types/ai.ts src/orchestration/**/*.test.ts | head -100 && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && rg -n '\"version\"|\"ajv\"' package-lock.json | head"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]|@spec|spec-anchor|validated by:\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -120 && sed -n '1,80p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && ls scripts | rg 'spec|anchor'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts package.json .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- package-lock.json | sed -n '1,240p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,80p' && git diff -- specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Validate missing required tool input" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
